description: This file contains utility functions for managing tensor sharding, distribution strategies, and registration in PyTorch's distributed tensor framework. It includes decorators for registering sharding propagation rules, strategies, and functions for verifying tensor shardability and layout mapping.

classes.name: DTensor
classes.description: A placeholder indicating the distribution of a tensor across devices.

classes.name: OpSchema
classes.description: Schema representing an operation's distributed properties.

classes.name: OpSpec
classes.description: A specific distribution strategy for an operation.

classes.name: OpStrategy
classes.description: A collection of strategies (multiple OpSpec) for an operation.

classes.name: OutputSharding
classes.description: Describes how outputs of an operation are sharded.

classes.name: Placement
classes.description: Base class for placement types such as Replicate, Shard, etc.

classes.name: Replication
classes.description: Placement indicating data is replicated across all devices.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Placement indicating data is sharded along a specific dimension.
